comment: What must not silently disappear from traefik. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Never operate a stack inferred from the plugin cache; resolv
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: never ask about anything in it
prose.rationale: Detection establishes the selected checkout and compatibility; asking for the same information adds avoidable setup work.

deterministic.step: Resolve and check the selected stack

nondeterministic.step: Choose the smallest service operation matching the user request
nondeterministic.why: User intent and application evidence determine the target and whether a mutation is authorized.

nondeterministic.step: Diagnose endpoint failures and verify useful recovery
nondeterministic.why: Container readiness alone cannot establish DNS, TLS, authorization or application correctness.

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.update_command: node ../../../skillfactory/skills/skillfactory/scripts/skillfactory.js freeze --repo ../../../.. --skill traefik --from /tmp/traefik-baseline-review --command 'node scripts/traefik.js check --input evals/capabilities.json --out "$OUT"' --trap-command 'node scripts/traefik.js check --input evals/incompatible.json'
baseline.rationale: A newer skill must reject missing operational capabilities; the golden pins the path-free projection of a real external CLI contract.
